# EcoBridgers

> EcoBridgers is a SaaS, IoT and embedded systems development company based in Surat, Gujarat, India. We build SaaS products, IoT hardware and firmware, web platforms and mobile apps for SMEs, factories and research labs.

Contact: ecobridgers.tech@gmail.com · +91 78629 49437 · Mon–Sat, 10am–7pm IST

## Partner portfolio
- [Portfolio for partners](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio): every EcoBridgers product and service in one place, with reseller, white-label, co-development, distribution, pilot and research partnership models
- Each product has a detail page at https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/<product-id> covering what it does, current phase, tech stack, business model, market and the co-founder role we are looking for

## Services
- [BIoTSense machine health monitoring](https://ecobridgers.com/work/biotsense): vibration, temperature and current sensors with live dashboards and anomaly alerts
- [SaaS Product Development](https://ecobridgers.com/services/saas): multi-tenant SaaS products for Indian SMEs
- [IoT & Embedded Systems](https://ecobridgers.com/services/iot): ESP32/STM32 firmware, sensors, MQTT, real-time dashboards
- [Mobile App Development](https://ecobridgers.com/services/app): Android and iOS apps
- [Web & Cloud Platforms](https://ecobridgers.com/services/web): Next.js, React, Node.js, AWS, Supabase

## Products
- [Water Tank](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/water-tank): smart water-level and pump controller; ESP32 ultrasonic sensor sends AES-encrypted LoRa readings to a pump unit controlled from a mobile app. About ₹4,000–5,000 one-time with a 1-year warranty; no plumber or electrician needed. Prototype: range and firmware testing, custom PCB next. Looking for distributors, sales and marketing partners
- [PCB Design Extension](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/pcb-design-extension): prototype EasyEDA extension that draws a schematic from a prompt; users bring their own AI tool, EcoBridgers provides the drawing tool and prompt enhancement. Not public yet; pricing not decided
- [Playco](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/playco): free desi party games app on Google Play with three games: Imposter (find the faker with clues and votes, online or pass and play), Colour Colour (race to snap a real object of the colour) and Chor Police (live-location team chase with QR catch). Ads live, in-app purchases planned. Download: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ecobridgers.playco
- [TextileBridge](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/textilebridge): textile production and yarn inventory management; on hold
- [CafeBridge](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/cafebridge): one app for India's food sellers, built first for street food: phone billing, cash/UPI tracking, daily expenses and profit, QR menu; plus KOT display, QR table ordering and inventory for cafes. Plans: Lite ₹300/month (₹3,000/year), Pro ₹500/month (₹5,000/year), Max ₹1,000/month (₹10,000/year), unlimited orders. Ready for launch
- [TurfBridge](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/turfbridge): sports turf and box cricket booking; on hold
- [Magic Outline](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/magic-outline): Adobe Photoshop plugin that extracts outlines from any design layer by layer, for designers and textile mills; digital printing now, embroidery next; in testing, pricing not decided
- [Machine Counter](https://ecobridgers.com/portfolio/machine-counter): counts every roll from each circular knitting machine with daily production reports and management software. ₹3,000–5,000 one-time per device, then ₹100–200 per device per year. PCB ready, phase-2 testing with partners; looking for knitting-unit clients
- [Underground Rover](https://ecobridgers.com/work/underground-rover): R&D rover for hazardous tunnel surveillance
